name: vscode-command-cli
description: Trigger VS Code commands from an external terminal through a VS Code URI handler.

commands.title: VS Code Command CLI: Copy URI Endpoint

vscodeCommandCli.enableLog.description: Write URI request and command execution logs to the VS Code Command CLI output channel.

scripts.build:client: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); fs.mkdirSync('bin',{recursive:true}); const version=require('./package.json').version; const result=spawnSync('go',['build','-ldflags','-X main.cliVersion='+version,'-o','bin/code-cli.exe','./cli'],{stdio:'inherit'}); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.package: npm run compile && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('bin', { recursive: true })" && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --out bin/vscode-command-cli.vsix
